phrases.meaning: Your RST (Readability, Signal, Tone) report is ...
phrases.description: A standard message containing an RST report for the receiving station.

examples.explanation: SP2FOX gives SP3ABC a RST report of 599. Perfectly clear & strong signal, perfect tone.

phrases.description: Usually heard at the end of a QSO. 'FER' is used instead of 'FOR' to save time.

examples.message: W2XYZ //DE// SP2FOX //UR RST// 599 599 TNX FER QSO
examples.explanation: SP2FOX gives SP3ABC a RST report of 599. Perfectly clear & strong signal, perfect tone.

prosigns.description: Indicates that a station is reporting a grave and imminent danger requiring immediate assistance. Reserved for genuine distress calls only.
examples: SOS SOS DE SP2FOX SP2FOX QTH JO93BD JO93BD
